slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
How often should you do Pilates to see results? The honest answer: as often as you can keep up 🧘

Many people aim for two or three sessions a week, but showing up most weeks for months usually matters more than a big burst followed by a long break. Most people first notice better movement awareness and control, with strength and endurance changes following over the coming weeks.

Five to ten minutes of home practice on non-class days helps the moves stick, and your program should progress once exercises start to feel easy.
